description: Trade Journal AI - An algorithmic trade review and analytics engine that analyzes JournalEntry history to produce actionable insights about trading behavior patterns, emotional correlations, setup-type performance, and personalized improvement recommendations. Pure rule-based analysis with no external AI dependencies.
steps: Create app/src/main/java/com/foxtrader/app/domain/usecase/ai/TradeJournalAi.kt - a class with @Inject constructor (no repository dependency - receives entries as parameter for testability). Core method: analyze(entries: List<JournalEntry>): JournalAiReport.

Create data classes in the same file: JournalAiReport (stats: JournalStats, behaviorPatterns: List<BehaviorPattern>, emotionAnalysis: EmotionAnalysis, setupRankings: List<SetupRanking>, streakAnalysis: StreakAnalysis, recommendations: List<String>, tradeReviews: List<TradeReview>). BehaviorPattern (type: PatternType enum [REVENGE_TRADING, OVERTRADING, FEAR_OF_MISSING_OUT, CONSISTENT_WINNER, IMPROVING_TREND, DECLINING_TREND], confidence: Int 0-100, evidence: String, suggestion: String). EmotionAnalysis (emotionWinRates: Map<EmotionTag, Double>, worstEmotion: EmotionTag?, bestEmotion: EmotionTag?, emotionPnlCorrelation: Map<EmotionTag, Double>). SetupRanking (setupType: String, tradeCount: Int, winRate: Double, avgR: Double, totalPnl: Double, grade: String). StreakAnalysis (currentStreak: Int, isWinStreak: Boolean, longestWinStreak: Int, longestLossStreak: Int, streakImpactOnBehavior: String). TradeReview (entryId: String, verdict: String [EXCELLENT, GOOD, ACCEPTABLE, POOR, TERRIBLE], reasons: List<String>, improvementTips: List<String>).

Implement behavior pattern detection: REVENGE_TRADING = loss followed by same-session entry with REVENGE/FOMO emotion tag; OVERTRADING = more than 5 trades in a single day with declining R-multiples; FEAR_OF_MISSING_OUT = entries with FOMO tag having worse win rate than average; IMPROVING_TREND = last 10 trades have higher average R than previous 10; DECLINING_TREND = opposite.

Implement trade review scoring: EXCELLENT = R >= 3.0 with PATIENT/CONFIDENT emotion; GOOD = R >= 1.5; ACCEPTABLE = R >= 0; POOR = loss with NEUTRAL emotion (missed management); TERRIBLE = loss with REVENGE/FOMO emotion.

Implement recommendations engine: aggregate patterns and emit personalized strings like 'Your FOMO trades lose X% more than average - consider a mandatory 10-minute cooling period' or 'Your best setup is X with Y% win rate - focus on this pattern'.

Create app/src/test/java/com/foxtrader/app/domain/usecase/ai/TradeJournalAiTest.kt - JUnit4 tests: detects revenge trading pattern, detects overtrading pattern, emotion analysis identifies worst emotion, setup rankings are sorted by average R, trade review grades correctly, empty input produces empty report, improving trend detected when recent trades are better.
acceptance_criteria: TradeJournalAi compiles with no android.* imports
Tests validate all behavior pattern detection algorithms
Emotion correlation analysis produces meaningful insights from JournalEntry data
Recommendations are personalized based on actual trading data patterns
Individual trade reviews provide actionable grading with improvement tips
verification: CI runs ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest and all new tests in TradeJournalAiTest pass
CI runs ./gradlew compileDebugKotlin and new source compiles without errors
